items.title: AXA Insurance UK joins Pool Re SME Incentive Scheme to embed terrorism cover
items.summary: AXA Insurance UK has joined Pool Re's SME Incentive Scheme to incorporate terrorism protection as standard into selected digital SME insurance products.

items.title: Fidelity International appoints Fabien Collado to London fixed income team
items.summary: Fidelity International has hired Fabien Collado as a portfolio manager in its investment grade fixed income team in London.

items.title: Barclays seeks insurer backing for over $10bn of AI infrastructure debt
items.summary: Barclays Plc is exploring options to buy credit risk protection on more than $10 billion of debt used to finance artificial intelligence infrastructure.

items.title: WTW risk and broking arm returns to 5% organic growth in third quarter
items.summary: WTW reported a rebound in its risk and broking segment alongside higher group revenue and increased cash flow.

items.title: Amundi posts €45.6bn in quarterly net inflows and 11% AUM rise
items.summary: Amundi reported net inflows of €45.6bn and an 11% year-on-year increase in assets under management for the third quarter.

items.title: The Pensions Regulator issues AI guidance for pension scheme trustees
items.summary: The Pensions Regulator has published new guidance to help trustees of pension schemes safely explore artificial intelligence opportunities and manage associated risks.
